title: Smile and Well
author: Tamsin Underhill
blurb: Elodie Halloran, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
